name: Indoor / outdoor sports complex
summary: Youth/amateur sports campus: a clear-span fieldhouse (courts, indoor turf) priced per building SF, plus outdoor synthetic or grass fields with lighting carried as per-field line items. Fieldhouse $/SF is anchored on RSMeans gymnasium/athletic-club models (2019) escalated by reasoning; outdoor field costs are derived allowances cross-checked against one municipal complex ($27M for 60 acres, 2017). Turf-field and lighting unit costs still need sourced bid tabs.

typicalSize.method: Fieldhouses for 4–12 basketball/volleyball courts are ~40,000–130,000 SF; destination complexes reach 200,000+ SF. Mid 100,000 SF building. Derived.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per acre of whole campus including outdoor fields and parking. e3 outdoor complex covers 60 acres; a 100,000 SF fieldhouse with 4 fields and parking needs ~12–20 acres → ~5,000–8,000 SF/acre. Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per building SF: ~40–60 spaces per court-equivalent tournament use ≈ 2–5 per 1,000 SF; fields add ~50–80 spaces each (not included here). Derived.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Fieldhouse building incl. its sitework, 2025 dollars. RSMeans 2019 hard cost: gymnasium $177 union / $162 open shop (e1); racquetball club $172 / $155 (e2). ×~1.30 to 2025 ≈ $205–230/SF for masonry gyms, + ~8% on-site work; large pre-engineered fieldhouses achieve lower $/SF through scale. Mid $210; low $140 = PEMB fieldhouse with minimal finishes; high $320 = masonry, mezzanines, spectator seating and premium finishes.

scope.notes: Fieldhouse building with courts/indoor turf surfaces and its on-site work and parking. Outdoor fields, field lighting and field parking are separate lineItems (not in baseline). Excludes land, soft costs, FF&E (scoreboards, bleachers if loose, equipment), off-sites.

qualityTiers.method: economy = low/mid (140/210); luxury = high/mid (320/210); premium interpolated.

systemSplit.method: Derived for a pre-engineered/clear-span fieldhouse: building system in 13 (≈12%) with 05 for mezzanines; large slab-on-grade (03 ≈ 11%); sports flooring and indoor turf in 09; HVAC for large volumes 10%; on-site work 8%. Not sourced.

lineItems.name: Outdoor full-size synthetic turf field (base, drainage, turf, infill, goals)

cost.method: Turf replacement alone (reusing base) was ≈ $650k per field in a Dec 2024 municipal award (e4); a new field adds stone base, drainage, curbs, fencing and goals. Derived: ~80,000–90,000 SF of field area at ~$11–20/SF for stone base, drainage and turf system, plus fencing/goals. Cross-check: e3 complex ≈ $27M over 60 acres (≈ $450k/acre incl. roads, parking, amenities) is consistent with ~$1.5–2.5M per field all-in. Needs bid-tab verification.

lineItems.notes: Count = number of outdoor fields (altUnit 'field'). Off by default (second pass): the type is priced per SF of fieldhouse and its range check excludes outdoor fields; switch on, or add an outdoor-fields component, when the project has them.

lineItems.name: LED sports lighting per field (poles, fixtures, controls)

cost.method: Derived allowance per lighted full-size field (6–8 poles).

lineItems.notes: Off by default (second pass): the type is priced per SF of fieldhouse and its range check excludes outdoor fields; switch on, or add an outdoor-fields component, when the project has them.

lineItems.name: Outdoor natural grass field with irrigation (alternative to synthetic)

cost.method: Derived allowance: grading, sand-cap or native soil, irrigation, sod.

lineItems.notes: Use instead of synthetic where appropriate; qty defaults to 0. Off by default (second pass): the type is priced per SF of fieldhouse and its range check excludes outdoor fields; switch on, or add an outdoor-fields component, when the project has them.

lineItems.name: Field parking, internal roads and walks (per field)

cost.method: Derived: ~60–80 surface spaces per field at $3–5k/space plus walks/roads.

lineItems.notes: Off by default (second pass): the type is priced per SF of fieldhouse and its range check excludes outdoor fields; switch on, or add an outdoor-fields component, when the project has them.

cost.method: Park restroom contracts $265k–$608k (amenities block) plus concessions kitchen.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Scoreboards, bleachers, divider curtains, basketball goals, volleyball systems, furniture. Derived.

pctOfHard.method: Clear-span buildings and fields have modest A&E (RSMeans model architectural fee ~7% of hard cost on e1), plus civil/stormwater for large impervious/turf areas, geotech, permits, testing. Derived.

softCosts.notes: Feasibility/market studies (common for municipal complexes) and tournament-operator selection are extra soft items.

design.method: Municipal programs often change field counts/amenities during design.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Fieldhouse building only: low 140×1.1; high 320×1.3. Outdoor fields excluded.

source.title: Gymnasium - Commercial Construction Costs Per Square Foot (RSMeans model page)

evidence.quote: Gymnasium with Concrete Block / Rigid Steel ... SubTotal 100% $141.48 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $35.37
evidence.scopeNotes: 2019 RSMeans national model, 20,000 SF, 1 story, union labor. value = subtotal + 25% contractor fees = $176.85/SF; open shop = $162.05/SF. Building only: excludes the architectural fees (6–8%) shown on the page, sitework, FF&E. Fieldhouse/court building proxy.

source.title: College Station City Council Awards A $1.3 Million Dollar Contract To Replace Artificial Turf At Two Fields At Veterans Park

evidence.quote: The College Station city council at its December meeting awarded a $1.3 million dollar contract to replace artificial turf on two soccer fields at Veterans Park.
evidence.scopeNotes: Turf replacement (existing base/drainage reused, no lighting) ≈ $650k per field; December 2024 award. New fields with stone base and drainage cost more.

openQuestions: Need municipal bid tabs for synthetic turf fields and LED field lighting (per field).
Need a public fieldhouse budget (city sports complex feasibility study) to replace the RSMeans-escalated $/SF.
